decisions.reason: The downward spout direction does not change the selected bowl capacity, depth, or form.
The existing valve, button, and controlled-flow requirements remain valid; pour direction is independently owned by the spout-geometry Requirement.
Changing the outlet direction does not modify the existing sealing or liquid-containment requirements.
The source specifies product geometry but does not change the system-layout deliverable or explicitly require a new CAD deliverable state.
The source does not select, replace, or require any component or BOM revision.
The downward pour direction does not alter spout removability, flushing, or cleaning requirements.
The source concerns preservation of drink consistency during dispensing, not a change to the independently defined mixing and frothing result.
Spout outlet direction does not change whisk size, material, position, attachment, or removal behavior.
The sourcing policy already permits custom render-style spouts, and the directional detail does not change that policy.
The spout direction does not change bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or assembly clearance.
The platform remains required for cup clearance, and the source does not change its height, supported cup size, fit, or configuration.
The spout geometry decision does not change the machine name, wording, placard placement, or displayed sides.
